title: Register native abort outcome code
summary: Register the native-process poll-abort outcome code so emitted NATIVE_ABORTED results are covered by outcome metadata and the failure-code registry gate.
reason: The reliability wrapper was blocked by a pre-existing registry gap: Native.ps1 emitted NATIVE_ABORTED, but FailureCodes.ps1 did not list it as a known outcome. That made the failure-code registry scan fail before later reliability checks could run.
behavior_before: Invoke-NativeProcess could emit NATIVE_ABORTED when a poll handler requested abort without a specific code, but Get-MediaPipelineKnownOutcomeCodes did not include that outcome, so Invoke-FailureCodeRegistryChecks.ps1 failed with an unknown emitted code.
behavior_after: NATIVE_ABORTED is a known process-lifecycle outcome with retryable warning metadata handled by the native process surface, and the registry check pins that metadata explicitly.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.check_dependency_boundaries --max-internal-imports 1 - passed with existing allowlisted hard findings and warnings only
apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.generate_project_index - passed; regenerated PROJECT_INDEX and DEPENDENCY_GRAPH from 1756 summaries

pwsh -NoProfile -File ops/pipeline/tests/Invoke-ReliabilityRegressionChecks.ps1 - failure-code registry step now passed, then wrapper failed later on unrelated Invoke-MediaRouteSelectionChecks.ps1 assertion: unknown-height movie expected encode but got remux
pwsh -NoProfile -File ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-FailureCodeRegistryChecks.ps1 - passed; classifier codes 38, outcome codes 159, emitted codes scanned 93
pwsh -NoProfile -File ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-MediaRouteSelectionChecks.ps1 - failed independently on unrelated route-selection assertion: unknown-height movie expected encode but got remux
rollback_plan: Remove NATIVE_ABORTED from Get-MediaPipelineKnownOutcomeCodes and remove the explicit NATIVE_ABORTED metadata assertion from Invoke-FailureCodeRegistryChecks.ps1.
notes:
This is registry/test metadata only. It does not change native-process execution, abort behavior, cleanup, retry behavior, or media policy.
This packet fixes the NATIVE_ABORTED registry blocker only. The remaining reliability-wrapper failure is in media route selection and no route-policy files are touched in this change.
